title: MY RESPONSE TO THREE DIFFICULT SITUATIONS

questions.prompt: Your supervisor corrects a mistake you believe was not entirely your fault. Which response would you choose, and why? (Explain immediately why someone else contributed / Listen, clarify the facts respectfully, and agree on how to resolve the issue / Remain silent but complain to a colleague later.)

A colleague you previously disagreed with does not respond warmly to your greeting. Which response would you choose, and why? (Continue being polite and professional without demanding a particular response / Conclude that the colleague dislikes you and stop cooperating / Tell another colleague that the person is holding a grudge.)

A client complains about an aspect of their massage session. Which response would you choose, and why? (Argue that you followed the procedure correctly / Dismiss the complaint because you feel criticised / Listen, acknowledge the concern, and follow Zura Spa's client-complaint procedure.)
